eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.newValue_: Initial value of the V2 variable.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

params.deadline: Last valid second of the signature (unix time).
params.name: The pseudo, 3 to 14 characters among A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and "_".
params.signature: The player's signature (65 bytes for an EOA, anything for an ERC-1271 wallet).

params.account: The player whose pseudo is released.
params.admin: The admin who signed; must hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
params.deadline: Last valid second of the signature (unix time).

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). Emits a {RoleRevoked} event if the calling account had `role` and this call successfully revoked it. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

MIN_LENGTH().notice: Shortest and longest pseudo a player may register.

OPERATOR_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to relay signed registrations and releases (the game's operator, SYSTEM).

REGISTER_TYPEHASH().notice: EIP-712 type a player signs to take a pseudo.

RELEASE_TYPEHASH().notice: EIP-712 type an admin signs to release a player's pseudo.

UPGRADER_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to upgrade the implementation.

assign(address,string).notice: Gives a reserved name to an account (e.g. "V", "SYSTEM"), shorter names allowed. Admin only.

holderOf(string).notice: The holder of a name, exact case (zero address if free). Reverts on a malformed name.

initializeV2(uint256).notice: One-off V2 setup, callable once and only on a proxy already initialized as V1.

isAvailable(string).notice: Whether a player could register this name now (well-formed and free).

isReserved(string).notice: Whether a name is reserved for the team, ignoring case ("Admin", "ADMIN" and "admin" all are).         Players cannot register it; the admin can still `assign` it. Case-sensitivity of ordinary names is         unchanged (V's rule), so only these impersonation-prone words are folded.

nameOf(address).notice: The pseudo of an account ("" if none).

nonces(address).notice: Current signature nonce of an account (part of the `Register` and `Release` messages).

register(address,string,uint256,bytes).notice: Records the pseudo a player signed for (EIP-712 `Register`), relayed by the operator.

registerDigest(address,string,uint256).notice: EIP-712 digest a player signs to register `name` (for wallets and the game client).

release(address).notice: Releases a player's pseudo (moderation). Admin only.

releaseWithSignature(address,address,uin.notice: Releases a pseudo with an admin's signature (EIP-712 `Release`), relayed by the operator.

version().notice: Version of this implementation, bumped by every upgrade.
